name: Bahamas
dek: Lynden Pindling International Airport, WMO 78073, Nassau.
paragraphs: The only station in the Bahamas submission is Lynden Pindling International Airport, WMO 78073, height 8 m, on New Providence. The Out Islands are not in the file. The Bahamas drives on the left.

The highest average high in the table is 32.8 °C, in August. The lowest average low is 18.2 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is June, at 220.0 mm, and the driest is December, at 43.2 mm.

climate.caption: Reference station: Lynden Pindling International Airport, WMO 78073.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. The file prints the position to the minute only and has no number-of-years rows.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO climate normals 1991-2020, Lynden Pindling International Airport (78073)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 120 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Bahamas at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism FAQ says UK rules apply in The Bahamas, "so please drive on the left and be very careful on the roundabouts."

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.value: 15% for most servers; check the bill
tipping.detail: The Bahamas Ministry of Tourism FAQ says tipping is customary and should follow the quality of service, that bellboys and porters usually receive $1 per bag and most other servers, such as waiters and taxis, 15%, and that many establishments include the gratuity in the total.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for The Bahamas, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Bahamian Dollar and the code BSD under the country name Bahamas (The).

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives the Bahamas one row, America/Nassau. zone1970.tab puts the Bahamas on the America/Toronto row with Canada, and the backward file links America/Nassau to America/Toronto. This sheet prints America/Nassau, the name zone.tab gives the Bahamas.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: The immigration department's site. We do not restate a visa rule.
